title: Kitchen Confidential
author: Anthony Bourdain
summary: Chef Anthony Bourdain recalls his path through restaurant kitchens and the rowdy, hard-drinking crews who run them. He mixes war stories with blunt advice about eating out.
readIf: you enjoy loud, profane, behind-the-scenes stories about work and food.
skipIf: you want a polished cookbook or a gentle read about cooking.
